text:
Ana Reyes: Heads up — Olivia from Brightline asked for a short explainer we can include in their renewal packet. They want a ~90s video + a 1‑page handout that explains how SLA credits work (uptime bands, latency targets, simple examples). Can CS + Product help produce?
Mike Chen: I can draft the script + a 2‑slide PDF handout. Need the definitive SLO numbers and a couple of concrete credit examples. Who owns the canonical table?
Devon Patel: I have the SLO spreadsheet for prod/dedicated/private. Ana — which tier is Brightline on? That changes thresholds and examples.
Ana Reyes: Brightline is Enterprise Dedicated. Our contract calls out 99.95% uptime and latency targets: P95 < 250ms for hosted inference routes (Dedicated has slightly different language). They specifically want billing-friendly examples for their finance team.
Olivia Grant: Confirming — billing asked for a one‑pager they can hand to procurement. Video can be presenter‑led. Happy to review script and the handout.
Mike Chen: Proposed video flow: 1) 15s intro (who we are), 2) 20s what SLA covers, 3) 30s two credit examples, 4) 25s how to claim and timelines. Need legal blurb for exact credit application text.
SLO Bot: ticket CS-4521 created for "SLA explainer video + handout" — assignees Mike Chen, Devon Patel; status: open.
Devon Patel: Draft credit table for Dedicated (proposal, needs Legal signoff): uptime 99.95–100.00 => 0% credit; 99.90–99.95 => 5% monthly service credit; <99.90 => 10% monthly service credit. Example copy for script: "For Dedicated customers we aim for 99.95% availability. If availability falls below the agreed threshold, eligible credits are applied to your next invoice after verification."
Ana Reyes: Mike — can you produce script + two‑slide PDF by EOD Friday? I’ll loop in Legal and CC Olivia for review once ready.
Mike Chen: On it. I'll post the draft script + PDF in this thread and attach a Loom for quick review. @Olivia — any phrasing preferences for customer-facing language?
Olivia Grant: Prefer the phrase "credits processed within the next invoice cycle" and include an explicit note about maintenance windows: "Scheduled maintenance is excluded from uptime calculations." Include that in both video and handout.
Mike Chen: Will add those lines. Draft FAQ line to include on handout: "Q: Are credits automatic? A: After our verification process, credits are applied on the next invoice cycle."
Ana Reyes: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If Legal wants stronger wording, we’ll update and re-record a short segment. Will flag renewal risk items separately if Brightline raises questions during review.
Mike Chen: Draft will be here by EOD Friday. If anyone has quick examples of past credit calculations (anonymized), drop them here and I’ll add as an extra example.
Olivia Grant: I can share one anonymized billing example offline. Thanks!
